description: This file provides helper functions for a chess clock implementation, including time adjustment calculations for Fischer and Bronstein modes and formatting milliseconds into human-readable clock strings.

methods.name: applyPostMoveTimeAdjustment( timeAfterSpendMs, timeSpentMs, mode, incrementOrDelaySeconds )
methods.description: Calculates the post-move time adjustment for Fischer and Bronstein increment modes based on remaining time, time spent, and specified increment or delay.

methods.name: formatClock(ms)
methods.description: Converts a time duration in milliseconds into a formatted clock string suitable for display.
